requires: preregistered suffix information gate in both seeds at 1000
parent: each seed's selected R arm and its optimizer, sampler and budget RNG at 1000
control: C0 independently continues the same seed R00 with the same 300 data and budget updates
residual: 16-wide S32 depthwise branch with zero-initialized output, using the received Fine embedding, valid mask and upsampled S64 coarse feature
detail: L1 on RGB minus a reflected 3x3 box mean, with the same reconstruction-budget weights
second_seed: repeat winner, D0 and independently continued R00/C0 at the same 1300 cumulative updates
performance: eligible only after information and all quality requirements pass in both seeds; unchanged genuine packet bytes, RGB and feature states under a shared execution identity
benchmark_reference: measure selected unoptimized paths even if quality gate stops speed optimization
